purpose: Apply source completeness, original contract scope, point-in-time, semantic independence and raw-state gates to every remaining local data-family route before formula or numeric access.

admission_gate.gate_1_accepted_full_2019_2023_history: A four-symbol, one-session or acceptance-only sample cannot enter historical research, and a terminal full-source failure cannot be shortened or filled.
admission_gate.gate_2_original_contract_permits_new_fac: Local bytes remain bound by the collection contract; a one-factor contract cannot be reused for an entropy, category, denominator or raw-operand alternative after results.
admission_gate.gate_3_new_economic_state: The proposal must observe an independent economic state rather than invert, rescale, lag, threshold or recombine a terminal factor and its operands.
admission_gate.gate_4_point_in_time_rankability: Identity, provider, retrieval time, report keys, group mappings and error flags are not issuer alpha values.
admission_gate.gate_5_raw_not_derived_or_failure_artifa: Stored feature values, failed-session tables, reconciliation status and historical scores cannot be recycled as a new raw source.
admission_gate.pass_rule: All five gates must pass before formula, direction, support, source rows, comparator values or returns.

finite_residual_catalog.name: classified_moneyflow_bucket_entropy_small_order_share_or_alternate_imbalance
finite_residual_catalog.reason: The immutable contract authorizes exactly one large-order net-inflow share. Campaign143 already rejected four-bucket entropy and forbids category or denominator changes even though the raw bucket amounts are local.

finite_residual_catalog.name: raw_pb_share_supply_or_industry_membership_alternative_state
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_source: daily PB, free-float shares and SW2021 membership
finite_residual_catalog.reason: PB and inverse book-to-market are the same valuation state; total/free shares are the operands of the terminal scarcity ratio; membership intervals are a point-in-time grouping taxonomy whose tenure and transition reinterpretations are closed.

finite_residual_catalog.name: raw_accounting_operand_scale_transition_or_cross_ratio
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_source: balance-sheet resilience, core-profit consistency, monetary-funds intensity and related-party sparsity
finite_residual_catalog.reason: Assets, liabilities, operating/total profit and monetary funds are frozen operands of terminal ratios; raw magnitudes need a denominator, while choosing a new denominator, lag or cross-ratio after results changes the closed formula state. Related-party count and its inverse are identical ordering.

finite_residual_catalog.name: context_count_identity_provider_retrieval_or_report_key_signal
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_source: audit counts, provider strings, identifiers, retrieval timestamps and report keys
finite_residual_catalog.reason: These fields establish source provenance, mapping, availability or diagnostics. Audit report count is contract context; provider/retrieval/file identity and report keys cannot be ranked as issuer information.

finite_residual_catalog.name: acceptance_only_cash_conversion_gross_margin_contract_liability_or_cninfo_event_factor
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_source: acceptance samples whose full-history contracts failed or terminalized
finite_residual_catalog.reason: Cash conversion, gross margin and contract-liability full histories failed their frozen source gates; the two CNINFO full-source branches failed title-markup or pagination stability. Acceptance rows cannot be extrapolated, and these failures do not establish predictive ineffectiveness.

finite_residual_catalog.name: minute_or_daily_operator_refresh_failure_missingness_or_stored_feature_signal
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_source: accepted OHLCVA/daily basis plus derived features, failure exports and historical experiment outputs
finite_residual_catalog.reason: Daily OHLCV/turnover/price-basis and minute OHLCVA already support the frozen terminal libraries. Another operator without a new observed state is a statistic refresh; reconciliation failures, missingness, derived feature values and stored scores are research diagnostics, not raw alpha.

decision.reason: No remaining local family simultaneously supplies accepted complete history, contract permission, a new rankable economic state and raw point-in-time values.

next_action: Record the six residual-route decisions, preserve the 157/142 library, and authorize Campaign160 only from a genuinely new raw state or a separately frozen complete source contract.
